item: Row 272: an unreadable law catalogue writes null, never 0, for the states nothing looked up
summary: With the catalogue unreadable the floor and world blocks wrote 0 and empty lists for verified-not-yet-tracked, unverified and no-eligible-source (and 0 research counts), and the Living sources law panel drew Not verified 0 and No eligible source 0 beside its caveat. The report now writes null for each (FLOOR_NEEDS_CATALOG); the panel leaves such a state out, the KPI record keeps null, the read-back prints not looked up.
